Paymos (Pay with crypto): Name shown to customers on the checkout payment step.
Paymos（加密货币付款）: 在收银台付款步骤向买家显示的名称。

Paymos (Pay with crypto): Sandbox uses test credentials; Live takes real payments. Connect Paymos for the selected mode before enabling checkout.
Paymos（加密货币付款）: 沙盒使用测试密钥，正式模式接收真实付款。启用收银台之前，请为所选模式连接 Paymos。

Paymos (Pay with crypto): Status applied while the customer is paying (before confirmation).
Paymos（加密货币付款）: 买家付款期间（确认前）应用的状态。

Paymos (Pay with crypto): Status applied once Paymos confirms the payment. The order is invoiced and moved to the Processing state.
Paymos（加密货币付款）: Paymos 确认付款后应用的状态。订单将生成账单并进入「处理中」状态。

Paymos (Pay with crypto): Write diagnostics to var/log/paymos.log. Leave off in production.
Paymos（加密货币付款）: 将诊断信息写入 var/log/paymos.log。生产环境请保持关闭。

Paymos (Pay with crypto): Click Connect Paymos and approve this store in your Paymos dashboard.
Paymos（加密货币付款）: 点击「连接 Paymos」，并在 Paymos 控制台中批准本商店。

Paymos (Pay with crypto): Customer is paying via Paymos. Invoice: %1
Paymos（加密货币付款）: 买家正在通过 Paymos 付款。账单：%1

Paymos (Pay with crypto): You will be redirected to Paymos to complete your payment with crypto.
Paymos（加密货币付款）: 将跳转到 Paymos 完成加密货币付款。

Paymos (Pay with crypto): We could not find your order. Please try again.
Paymos（加密货币付款）: 未找到你的订单，请重试。

Paymos (Pay with crypto): We could not start the crypto payment: %1
Paymos（加密货币付款）: 无法发起加密货币付款：%1

Paymos (Pay with crypto): We could not start the crypto payment. Please choose another method.
Paymos（加密货币付款）: 无法发起加密货币付款，请选择其他支付方式。
